create_CoefficientMapping: create a CoefficientMapping module with lmax and mmax to pre-compute spherical harmonic coefficient indices
use_CoefficientMapping_coefficient_idx: use CoefficientMapping.coefficient_idx to get indices of coefficients less than or equal to a given degree and order
use_CoefficientMapping_complex_idx: use CoefficientMapping.complex_idx to get real and imaginary index masks for a specific harmonic order m
create_SO3_Grid: create an SO3_Grid module with lmax and mmax to build to-grid and from-grid transformation matrices
use_SO3_Grid_to_grid_from_grid: use SO3_Grid.to_grid and from_grid to transform between irreps embeddings and grid representations on SO3
